READ_ONLY_HELP: View commitments and open the original record to work on it. Each item remains in its own module.
NO_MODULES: None of the agenda modules is available to you.
PERIOD_HELP: Views and filters respect the selected period. Overdue items may include deadlines earlier today.
NO_FILTER_RESULTS: No accessible commitments match these filters.
EMPTY: No commitments in this view and period.
UNDATED_HELP: Undated items remain in their source lists. Project deadlines are dates only; CRM uses the recorded date and time.
AGENDA_DESCRIPTION: CRM and Project commitments without duplicating source records.
TASK_NOT_FOUND: This task is no longer available in this ticket.
SERVICE_DESK_UNAVAILABLE: Service Desk tasks are not available in this version.
